parameters.note: Jamison Lake is not listed in CCR §7.40(b) or §7.50(b), so it falls under the general statewide lake regulation in §5.85(a)(1).

candidates.summary: Open all year (general statewide lake regulation; not listed as a special-regulation water)

parameters.counting_rule: General statewide trout limit for inland lakes, reservoirs, and ponds: five-trout daily bag limit and ten-trout possession limit.

candidates.authorityName: California Department of Fish and Wildlife

parameters.note: Anglers 16 years of age or older must have a valid California sport fishing license.

candidates.citation: USFS — Plumas National Forest, Lakes Basin Recreation Area

parameters.description: Jamison Lake sits in the Plumas National Forest's Lakes Basin Recreation Area; USFS permits backpack camping at only five lakes in the recreation area, including Jamison Lake, and campers using a camp stove in that area should carry a California Campfire Permit.

candidates.summary: Jamison Lake is one of only five lakes in the Lakes Basin Recreation Area where USFS permits backpack camping; a California Campfire Permit is advised for camp stove use.
